info.title: DATN-90 Team R4 — OFFLINE REVIEW CANDIDATE
info.description: PROPOSAL for explicit policy choices P1-P5 in ../11-team-foundation-runtime-options-r4.md. The candidate serializes option A for each policy; no selection has been approved. P6 is a separate evidence checklist, currently NOT READY. Preserves selected TQ01-04/TQ09 scope. No runtime registration, DB change or deployment.

x-error-precedence: Auth/context → CSRF mutation → shape (malformed target ID404) → scoped visibility → current action → command headers → scoped fingerprint/replay → new-command If-Match → state → session-bound fences/full next-state validation/write/audit. Hidden valid-shape resource404 before key/version/result; invalid body may422 before lookup. Gateway policy is outside IAM precedence.
x-rate-limiting: No new Team quota selected; owning Gateway may add existing-policy429/Retry-After/shared envelope, pending exact evidence. Not claimed in operation responses.
x-audit-candidate: Direct atomic continuum_audit.audit_logs_iam with Team+durable result, same client/session; TEAM_CREATED/TEAM_METADATA_UPDATED/TEAM_ARCHIVED/TEAM_RESTORED; Team target; payload allowlist/dedup/append-only. No Team outbox/history. TQ10 still DEFER.
x-lifecycle: Create ACTIVE/version1/archive fields null. Update only ACTIVE. Changed metadata/archive/restore increments version once; no-op preserves version and updatedAt, no business event but durable command result. Retain ID/code/references. No hard delete/cascade/membership rewrites.
x-pagination: createdAt DESC,id DESC; scope/visibility before count/page. Empty totalPages0; beyond page data=[] retains totals; no cross-request snapshot guarantee. Unknown/array/operator queries rejected.
